listening.title: Monthly report to the admin manager

lines.speaker: Chị Mai (Admin Manager)
lines.text: Morning, Nam. Do you have ten minutes to go through your monthly report?

lines.speaker: Nam (Admin Officer)
lines.text: Yes, of course. Let me start with a quick snapshot of the three projects.

lines.speaker: Chị Mai (Admin Manager)
lines.text: Great. How is the office move going?

lines.speaker: Nam (Admin Officer)
lines.text: It's on schedule. The target date is still the fifteenth of November.

lines.speaker: Chị Mai (Admin Manager)
lines.text: Good to hear. And the new training handbook?

lines.speaker: Nam (Admin Officer)
lines.text: That deliverable is a bit late. The HR team hasn't sent me the leave policy section yet.

lines.speaker: Chị Mai (Admin Manager)
lines.text: I see. Do you need me to talk to them?

lines.speaker: Nam (Admin Officer)
lines.text: Yes, please. I put it under 'support needed'. A short message from you would really help.

lines.speaker: Chị Mai (Admin Manager)
lines.text: No problem. What was your main achievement this month?

lines.speaker: Nam (Admin Officer)
lines.text: We cut printing costs by twenty percent. I'll add the numbers to your briefing for the director.
